description.value: NoodleBox is a Canadian fast-casual franchise specializing in customizable wok-fired Asian noodle and rice dishes, with sauces spanning Pad Thai, Cambodian Jungle Curry, Kung Pao, and beyond. Every box is made to order at the counter, and a range of dishes can be modified for vegan or gluten-friendly diets on request. Touring cyclists in the Tri-Cities area can stop in for a hot, filling meal with their choice of protein, noodle type, and sauce.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies NoodleBox as a fast-food Asian restaurant at 863 Village Drive, Unit 150, V3B 8B2; the corporate website at noodlebox.ca was successfully fetched and confirms this is a franchise of the Canadian NoodleBox chain. The website explicitly advertises vegan and gluten-friendly menu modifications, and the counter-service and app-ordering model confirms takeout; no bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags. The OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but postal code V3B 8B2 and the coordinates (49.253°N, 122.738°W) place this location in Port Coquitlam, not North Vancouver.
